643-1168-3510-6291.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-1168-3510-6291.description:

Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

4279-4699-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4699-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.

3819-5671-5928.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Balduvian Trading Post from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Balduvian Trading Post into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Balduvian Trading Post from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Balduvian Trading Post from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Balduvian Trading Post into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
3819-5671-5928.notes: You can return other lands with their dredge abilities instead, as you're able to do so.

1409-3099-5223-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Palladium Myr.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Palladium Myr.
Repeat.

413-2074-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Vorapede enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Vorapede enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-2074-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

465-719-3742-4251-4460.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-5659.description:

Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.

When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.

3967-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3234-3293-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
997-3234-3293-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat
997-3234-3293-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

32-1618-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
32-1618-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Trespass and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
32-1618-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Temporal Trespass by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Temporal Trespass and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Trespass, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Temporal Trespass and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Temporal Trespass and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Temporal Trespass's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
32-1618-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat from step 1.
